in_sanskrit.name: Jivanya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Life
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jivanya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jivanya is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'jivan', meaning 'life'. The name signifies the goddess of life, and is believed to bring vitality and energy to the one who bears it. In Hindu mythology, Jivanya is often associated with the goddess Durga, who represents the power and energy of life.
